items.title: Summer Blockbusters Are Filling Movie Theaters. Here’s Who’s Cashing In.
items.summary: Hollywood just marked its fourth consecutive $1 billion month of domestic box office sales, and movie theater operators are celebrating.  The July 31 opening of Sony Pictures’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day launched  AMC Entertainment  to its highest revenue weekend for tickets and food-and-beverage sales in its 106-year history, counting more than 10.2 million moviegoers in its theaters in the U.S. and worldwide.  According to CEO Adam Aron, Spider-Man was the ninth movie title since March to have a “gangbusters opening-weekend gross.”
